title: Bringing Industry 5.0 Technology Labs to Shape the Future
body:
NSRIT and NIAT are launching Industry 5.0 technology labs that could change everything for students here in Visakhapatnam. These aren't your typical college labs — we're talking AI, robotics, IoT, automation, AR/VR, and human-centered innovation facilities that actually let you build real stuff.

The newly introduced labs focus on emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, IoT, Automation, Smart Systems, AR/VR, and Human-Centered Innovation. These advanced facilities are designed to provide students with hands-on experience, encouraging them to move beyond theoretical learning and explore real-world applications of technology.

By bringing cutting-edge infrastructure and innovation-driven programs to the campus, NIAT is creating an ecosystem where creativity, research, teamwork, and technical excellence can thrive together. Students are now gaining opportunities to work on live projects, develop smart solutions, and participate in workshops, hackathons, and research activities that match current industry standards.

This transformation highlights NSRIT’s commitment to building a future-focused educational environment where technology and innovation empower young minds. The Industry 5.0 initiative is not only enhancing technical education but also inspiring students to become innovators, problem-solvers, and future leaders in the rapidly evolving digital world.
